Definition: Redefining a group on the spot to exclude a counterexample, so the original claim can never be challenged. The definition moves whenever evidence appears.
Example: After hearing of a kind Scotsman who disproves a stereotype, someone replies, 'Well, no true Scotsman would act that way.'
FaithDiscussionExample: When a professing Christian behaves badly, someone says, 'No true Christian would ever do that,' instead of honestly acknowledging failure and the need for repentance.
HowToRespond: Be honest about real examples: 'Christians, like everyone, can fail badly. Rather than redefine the word, let us look at what Christ actually calls His followers to be.'
